newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end mostly higher.

text.p: May 19 - U.S. stock index futures ended higher, off peaks. Brokers said closing trade stayed quiet, with day's gains tied to dealer buying, local covering, before Tuesday's FOMC meeting. Stocks stayed up despite weakness in T-bond futures. Some said Friday's fall worked off overbought condition, stocks could rise again if Fed does nothing or hikes 25 bps.
